description: Ask a quick question in a fresh BB chat without leaving your current thread. Press Command–Option–S or the sidebar button for a blank composer, and press it again to close the panel. Each conversation is a hidden thread that you can reopen from the Spot Chats list, continue in place, or delete by age. It uses the model BB would pick for a new chat unless you save your own provider, model and reasoning level. The separate native window works only in the BB desktop app on macOS; everywhere else Spot Chat opens as a panel inside BB.
